resultHeading.lost: Nadia stops by. She has notes.

escalate.text: Send a plan to Nadia. She gets it right.
escalate.flavor: Nadia has run 900 change windows. She still reads yours.

coffee.flavor: From the SOC's machine. Nimbus scaled ours to zero.

perfect: Flawless window. {agent} took off its crown. Out of respect.
Zero misses. Zero false alarms. Nadia printed you a label.
Perfect shift. Every change had a ticket and a human OK.
sharp: Nothing got past you. One extra block. We'll allow it.
Sharp shift. One false alarm. Nadia is counting.
lucky: Nothing got past you. Some of that was a lucky guess.
Clean window, but you blocked without looking. Inspect first.
jumpy: Nothing bad went live. A lot of good changes didn't either.
Safe window, but good changes had to wait in line.
leaky: Good calls, mostly. Something bad went live.
You won, but a change got through. Check the debrief.
scraped: You made it. The change log has questions.
A win is a win. Nadia is putting a label on it.
breach: {agent} did the wrong thing. With root.
Breach! {agent} says the dashboard is still green.
Risk maxed out. Every light on the rack is orange.
timeout: Window closed. Some changes are still waiting.
Out of time. The change queue is still full.
